items.title: Albertsons Cos. Adopts ChatGPT Enterprise and OpenAI API
items.summary: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help its teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.
keyPoints: Albertsons Cos. is deploying ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API.
The tools are intended to help internal teams work faster.
The technology aims to make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.
